mods.name: delegation-board
mods.summary: A live pane of the session's subagents and teammates: type, model, effort, state, elapsed time, tokens, an optional cost estimate and the task description. It only observes; nothing leaves the machine.
mods.install: claude plugin marketplace add iuliandita/mods && claude plugin install delegation-board@iuliandita-mods

opencode.install: clone this repository and add {"package": "<clone>/mods/delegation-board/opencode"} to "plugins" in ~/.config/opencode/cli.json

mods.name: guard-rules
mods.summary: Blocks AI attribution in commits and PRs, direct commits to protected branches, commits under the wrong git identity, and mutating kubectl, helm and terraform calls on protected or unclassified environments.
mods.install: claude plugin marketplace add iuliandita/mods && claude plugin install guard-rules@iuliandita-mods

codex.install: codex plugin marketplace add iuliandita/mods && codex plugin add guard-rules@iuliandita-mods

opencode.install: clone this repository and add {"package": "<clone>/mods/guard-rules/opencode"} to "plugins" in opencode.json

mods.name: secret-box
mods.summary: Resolves {{secret:NAME}} placeholders from Linux Secret Service or macOS Keychain at execution time, with optional directory scopes and host-specific output scrubbing.
mods.install: claude plugin marketplace add iuliandita/mods && claude plugin install secret-box@iuliandita-mods

codex.install: codex plugin marketplace add iuliandita/mods && codex plugin add secret-box@iuliandita-mods

opencode.install: clone this repository and add {"package": "<clone>/mods/secret-box/opencode"} to "plugins" in opencode.json

mods.name: statusline
mods.summary: A two-row status line in the band above the prompt, in the terminal and in Claude Desktop: model and effort, worktree, branch and counts, lines changed, kube context, PR and issue counts, session name and output style; then context, 5h and 7d rate-limit bars with pace, cache, cost and time. No statusLine script. In a git repo with a GitHub or GitLab remote it runs gh or glab for the PR and issue counts (forge option, on by default).
mods.install: claude plugin marketplace add iuliandita/mods && claude plugin install statusline@iuliandita-mods

opencode.install: clone this repository and add {"package": "<clone>/mods/statusline/opencode"} to "plugins" in ~/.config/opencode/cli.json
